title: A MESSAGE FROM #JOHN THE #REVELATOR
segments: as I sit here reminiscing about my long
eventful life I cannot help but Marvel
at the hand of Providence that has
guided my
footsteps my name is John and I am one
of the original 12 Apostles chosen by
our Lord Jesus Christ I have witnessed
remarkable Miracles heard or inspiring
teachings and watched an amazement as
the early church grew and spread but my
journey as a follow of Christ has not
been an easy one like my companions I
faced persecution and the constant
threat of death in the wave of
persecution that swept through Rome I
was condemned to face martyrdom they
prepared a huge Bassin of boiling oil
intending to end my life in the most
agonizing way possible yet as I was
lowered into that searing cauldron of
death a miracle occurred the scalding
liquid refused to harm me the Flames
licked at my skin but I felt no pain the
Lord had spared my life once again
preserving me for a greater purpose
however my salvation came at a course
following the failed execution I am
sentenced to the treacherous Minds on
the prison of island of Patmos in these
depths where Darkness Reigns I'm cut off
from the world isolated from the very
faith that sustains me yet it's on this
Des olate Island admidst the clanking of
chains and the backbreaking labor that I
experienced something extraordinary in
the midst of my suffering the heavens
opened and I received visions and
Revelations from the Divine it's here in
the depths of my despair that I was
tasked with writing the prophetic Book
of Revelation the words flowed unto
parchment inspired by an otherworldly
power as I beheld the mysteries of the
end of times as time pass I grow old and
weary the scars of my trials become
evident on my aged hands and face and
yet despite the hardships I Endure I
find peace I'm the only Apostle who did
not meet a violent end however I embrace
death as an old man quietly slipping
away from this Earthly Realm looking
back I realized that every step of my
journey had a purpose the trials the
suffering and the solitary moments here
in Patmos all serve to shape me into the
vessel through which God's Divine
message flowed my life is a testimony to
the resilience of Faith the power of
perseverance and the promise of
redemption now as I pass from this world
I am comforted by the knowledge that my
labor was not in vain the words I pend
here on this Stony Island will guide and
Inspire Believers Through the Ages and
so I bid farewell to this mortal world
knowing that the flame of my faith will
endure pass down from generation to
generation until the day of Christ's
glorious
return
